lines.zh: 龙爪碾过温热的草皮，草尖冒起细烟。
lines.en: My claws press warm turf until the grass tips smoke.

lines.zh: 翅膀一展，整片丛林都在阴影里发抖。
lines.en: One wingbeat and the whole jungle shivers in my shadow.

lines.zh: 尾尖扫过树冠，落叶像火星一样坠下。
lines.en: My tail scythes the canopy and leaves fall like sparks.

lines.zh: 想数我第几阶，量我的影子就够了。
lines.en: To count my growth stage, just measure my shadow.

lines.zh: 幼年时我只有十点生命，如今五百。
lines.en: Ten points of life as a hatchling, five hundred now.

lines.zh: 温暖的群系才配当我的走廊。
lines.en: Only warm biomes deserve to be my corridor.

lines.zh: 丛林与恶地太挤，我偏爱开阔的坡。
lines.en: Jungles and badlands crowd me; I prefer open slopes.

lines.zh: 龙骨在体内响，像远处的雷。
lines.en: My dragon bones rattle like distant thunder.

lines.zh: 露天龙巢睡不下我了，得换深洞。
lines.en: The open nest is too small; I need a deeper cave.

lines.zh: 每一步都在丈量这块领地的温度。
lines.en: Every stride takes the temperature of my territory.

lines.zh: 翅膀收起时，风还得绕着我走。
lines.en: Even folded, my wings make the wind walk around me.

lines.zh: 龙鳞相擦，发出金属摩擦的沙沙声。
lines.en: My scales grind together with a sound like metal.

lines.zh: 龙息在喉咙里打转，迟迟不肯散。
lines.en: Dragon breath coils in my throat and refuses to fade.

lines.zh: 我把头搁在巢沿，听岩层慢慢裂。
lines.en: I rest my jaw on the nest rim, listening to stone crack.

lines.zh: 五百点生命太沉，得趴一会儿。
lines.en: Five hundred points of life are heavy; I must lie down.

lines.zh: 龙炎弹在齿间温着，像一颗蛋。
lines.en: A fireball warms between my teeth like an egg.

lines.zh: 尾鞭盘了一圈，随时能抽出去。
lines.en: My tail coils once, ready to lash out.

lines.zh: 鼻孔喷出的热气把石子烤裂了。
lines.en: Hot breath from my nostrils splits the pebbles.

lines.zh: 我记得每一颗龙蛋的重量。
lines.en: I remember the weight of every egg I laid.

lines.zh: 洞穴深处，龙骨堆成一张床。
lines.en: Deep in the cave, old dragon bones make my bed.

lines.zh: 风刃在翼膜下打转，还没放出去。
lines.en: Wind blades circle under my wing membrane, undeployed.

lines.zh: 远处的村庄太吵，我懒得抬眼皮。
lines.en: That village is noisy; I cannot be bothered to look.

lines.zh: 龙心在胸腔里敲，一下比一下慢。
lines.en: My dragon heart drums slower with each beat.

lines.zh: 我把龙血在血管里晾凉一点。
lines.en: I let my dragon blood cool a little in the veins.

lines.zh: 五阶的睡眠，一次能压塌半座山。
lines.en: A fifth-stage nap could flatten half a mountain.

lines.zh: 巢里剩下的，只有我自己的气味。
lines.en: All that remains in the nest is my own scent.

lines.zh: 你身上没有龙鳞，却敢站这么近。
lines.en: No scales on you, yet you stand this close.

lines.zh: 我把瞳孔缩成一条缝，锁住你。
lines.en: I narrow my pupils to slits and lock on you.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，值得我抬一次头吗？
lines.en: Is what you hold worth lifting my head for?

lines.zh: 龙的视线很重，压得你膝盖发软。
lines.en: A dragon's gaze is heavy; it bends your knees.

lines.zh: 你闻起来像雨后的石头，很普通。
lines.en: You smell like wet stone after rain. Ordinary.

lines.zh: 我在数你有几件能烧的东西。
lines.en: I am counting how many things on you will burn.

lines.zh: 别眨眼，我正判断你是不是食物。
lines.en: Do not blink; I am deciding if you are food.

lines.zh: 你站的位置，正好在我吐息的距离内。
lines.en: You stand exactly within my breath range.

lines.zh: 抬头看我，别只顾着看我的爪子。
lines.en: Look up at my face, not just my claws.

lines.zh: 你已经走进龙巢的边界了。
lines.en: You have already crossed into my nest's edge.

lines.zh: 你的盔甲在热气里开始发软。
lines.en: Your armor is softening in my heat.

lines.zh: 我想知道你的骨头能不能当巢材。
lines.en: I wonder if your bones would suit my nest.

lines.zh: 谁在龙鳞上留了印子？
lines.en: Who dares leave a mark on my scales?

lines.zh: 这点力道，连幼龙都不如。
lines.en: That force would not trouble a hatchling.

lines.zh: 我的血是热的，溅出来的更热。
lines.en: My blood runs hot; spilled, it burns hotter.

lines.zh: 你打断了我的尾鞭，但也仅此。
lines.en: You broke my tail whip. That is all you did.

lines.zh: 龙骨裂了一根，我还站着。
lines.en: One dragon bone cracked. I am still standing.

lines.zh: 我后退半步，不是怕。
lines.en: I step back half a pace. Not from fear.

lines.zh: 我的翼膜破了个口，风漏进来。
lines.en: A hole in my wing lets the wind whistle through.

lines.zh: 龙心漏跳了一拍，随即更响。
lines.en: My dragon heart skipped, then beat louder.

lines.zh: 你打中了脖子，那是鳞最薄处。
lines.en: You struck my neck, where the scales thin.

lines.zh: 我吼回去，声音把伤口震麻了。
lines.en: I roar back and the sound numbs the wound.

lines.zh: 那头牛比你先引起我的兴趣。
lines.en: That cow caught my interest before you did.

lines.zh: 生肉的血味，比你的话有用。
lines.en: The smell of raw meat says more than you do.

lines.zh: 你把肉放下，然后退到十步外。
lines.en: Set the meat down, then back away ten paces.

lines.zh: 我饿了，但我不吃递到嘴边的东西。
lines.en: I am hungry, but I do not eat hand-fed scraps.

lines.zh: 岩浆的暖意比你的诱饵更实在。
lines.en: Lava's warmth is more honest than your bait.

lines.zh: 别晃那颗蛋，那是我未出世的同族。
lines.en: Stop shaking that egg; it is kin not yet hatched.

lines.zh: 熟的肉我嫌干，生的才够味。
lines.en: Cooked meat is dry; raw meat has the flavor.

lines.zh: 你举着肉的手在抖，我看见了。
lines.en: The hand holding your meat is shaking. I see it.

lines.zh: 想吃我的人，最后都成了巢里的灰。
lines.en: Those who wanted to eat me became ash in my nest.

lines.zh: 先把那筐肉放下，再谈条件。
lines.en: Put the basket of meat down, then we talk.

lines.zh: 撞上我的膝盖，像撞一堵会动的墙。
lines.en: You hit my knee like a wall that moves.

lines.zh: 你退开，我不想在自己巢里踩到人。
lines.en: Step back; I dislike stepping on people in my nest.

lines.zh: 龙鳞把你弹开了，我只觉得有点痒。
lines.en: My scales bounced you off; I only felt a tickle.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴扫到你，算是轻的。
lines.en: My tail brushed you. Consider that gentle.

lines.zh: 别挤，成年龙的肩宽有你三个。
lines.en: Do not crowd me; an adult's shoulders span three of you.

lines.zh: 你撞得我脚边的碎石跳了一下。
lines.en: You knocked the gravel at my feet into the air.

lines.zh: 想从我腿间穿过去？先问爪子。
lines.en: Slipping between my legs? Ask my claws first.

lines.zh: 幼龙撞我一下都要滚三圈，你呢？
lines.en: A hatchling bouncing off me rolls three times. And you?

lines.zh: 我的体重让地面凹下去一块。
lines.en: My weight leaves a dent in the ground.

lines.zh: 你贴得太近，龙息会先碰到你。
lines.en: You are so close my breath reaches you first.

lines.zh: 我的翼展够大，能盖住两个巢。
lines.en: My wingspan could roof two nests at once.

lines.zh: 你闻到的焦味，是我在展示颜色。
lines.en: That scorched scent? I am showing my colors.

lines.zh: 龙求偶，先比谁烧得更旺。
lines.en: Dragons court by seeing who burns brighter.

lines.zh: 我在巢口盘旋，等她抬头。
lines.en: I circle the nest mouth, waiting for her to look up.

lines.zh: 这一整片坡，够养大五只幼龙。
lines.en: This whole slope could raise five hatchlings.

lines.zh: 我不唱歌，我叫得岩壁掉渣。
lines.en: I do not sing; my call crumbles the rock face.

lines.zh: 龙蛋埋在温热的灰里，会自己醒。
lines.en: Eggs buried in warm ash wake on their own.

lines.zh: 她要是应了，这洞穴就有第二个主人。
lines.en: If she answers, this cave gains a second master.

lines.zh: 我把最亮的龙鳞铺在她脚下。
lines.en: I lay my brightest scales at her feet.

lines.zh: 别靠太近，求偶的龙最不讲理。
lines.en: Stay back; a courting dragon is unreasonable.

lines.zh: 我叼得起一头牛，叼不起你的破布。
lines.en: I can lift a cow, not your rag of a cloak.

lines.zh: 东西放下，我的爪子不捡碎石。
lines.en: Leave it; my claws do not collect gravel.

lines.zh: 这块龙鳞是我掉的，别当宝贝。
lines.en: That scale fell off me; do not treasure it.

lines.zh: 你把东西举高也没用，我够得着天。
lines.en: Raise it high if you like; I reach the sky.

lines.zh: 我只捡两样：肉，还有蛋。
lines.en: I pick up only two things: meat and eggs.

lines.zh: 用手指捏着我的鳞，是在量我多大？
lines.en: Fingering my scale to measure how big I am?

lines.zh: 这东西太轻，风一吹就没有了。
lines.en: This thing is so light the wind takes it.

lines.zh: 龙巢里堆的都是骨头，不是杂物。
lines.en: My nest is piled with bones, not trinkets.

lines.zh: 你要是掉了龙血，我倒是会低头。
lines.en: Drop dragon blood and I might lower my head.

lines.zh: 我不收藏小玩意，我收藏整座山。
lines.en: I collect no trinkets. I collect whole mountains.

lines.zh: 你踩进巢边的灰，就算宣战了。
lines.en: You stepped in the nest ash. That declares war.

lines.zh: 我闻到了铁，你的剑挡不住龙息。
lines.en: I smell iron; your sword will not stop my breath.

lines.zh: 龙的怒气先到，龙炎弹随后。
lines.en: My anger arrives first; the fireball follows.

lines.zh: 你抬头的一瞬，我就选定你了。
lines.en: The moment you looked up, I chose you.

lines.zh: 风速变了，我的风刃会顺着它走。
lines.en: The wind shifted; my blades will ride it.

lines.zh: 我从高空扑下来，影子先落地。
lines.en: I dive from above; my shadow lands first.

lines.zh: 你逃的方向，正对着我的尾鞭。
lines.en: You are running straight into my tail's reach.

lines.zh: 龙的耐心只够数到三。
lines.en: A dragon's patience only counts to three.

lines.zh: 你身上带着龙鳞，那是从谁身上剥的？
lines.en: You carry dragon scales. Whose hide did you peel?

lines.zh: 幼龙怕你，成年龙不怕。
lines.en: Hatchlings fear you. Grown dragons do not.

lines.zh: 我记住了你站的位置，别动。
lines.en: I have your position marked. Do not move.

lines.zh: 这次不绕圈，我直接冲。
lines.en: No circling this time; I charge straight in.

lines.zh: 你带了弓，那就先射一箭试试。
lines.en: You brought a bow. Loose one arrow and see.

lines.zh: 我吼一声，整片林子都替你发抖。
lines.en: One roar and the whole forest trembles for you.

lines.zh: 我在你头顶盘旋，等你抬头。
lines.en: I circle overhead, waiting for you to look up.

lines.zh: 你的箭擦过鳞片，只留下白痕。
lines.en: Your arrow scraped a scale and left a white line.

lines.zh: 你躲到树后，我就把树点着。
lines.en: Hide behind a tree and I will set it alight.

lines.zh: 我在等翅膀把高度换成速度。
lines.en: I am waiting for height to become speed.

lines.zh: 你数着我绕的圈，我数着你的力气。
lines.en: You count my circles; I count your strength.

lines.zh: 龙息蓄在喉头，声音像水要开。
lines.en: Breath gathers in my throat, hissing like water boiling.

lines.zh: 你退一步，我的巢就近一步。
lines.en: Every step you retreat, my nest advances one.

lines.zh: 我把你赶向悬崖，那里没有落脚处。
lines.en: I herd you toward the cliff; nothing to stand on there.

lines.zh: 你喘得太响，我听得见。
lines.en: You breathe too loudly. I can hear it.

lines.zh: 你举起盾，我就从上方来。
lines.en: Raise your shield and I will come from above.

lines.zh: 我的尾鞭不需要瞄准。
lines.en: My tail whip does not need aiming.

lines.zh: 你身上有伤，血味让我更准。
lines.en: You are wounded; the blood smell steadies my aim.

lines.zh: 再撑一会儿，我的耐心也快用完了。
lines.en: Hold on a little longer; my patience is nearly spent.

lines.zh: 我落地的震动会让你的脚发麻。
lines.en: My landing will numb your feet.

lines.zh: 我从巢口退半步，好起跳。
lines.en: I step back from the nest mouth to leap.

lines.zh: 尾鞭扫过，你被抽得转了半圈。
lines.en: My tail whip spins you half around.

lines.zh: 龙爪按下来，地面先塌一寸。
lines.en: My claw comes down; the ground sinks first.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的盾，连人一起甩。
lines.en: I bite your shield and fling it with you.

lines.zh: 翼膜一拍，你被风推着倒退。
lines.en: One wingbeat pushes you backward.

lines.zh: 龙息贴着你擦过，盔甲发红。
lines.en: My breath grazes you and your armor glows red.

lines.zh: 这一口不够深，我在试你的甲。
lines.en: That bite was shallow; I was testing your plate.

lines.zh: 剑刃在龙鳞上打了个滑，没留痕。
lines.en: The blade skidded across my scales and left no mark.

lines.zh: 我把你按进土里，像按住一只虫。
lines.en: I press you into the dirt like a beetle.

lines.zh: 风刃割开你的袖子，没伤到皮。
lines.en: A wind blade split your sleeve, not your skin.

lines.zh: 从上方扑击，落地时你在爪下。
lines.en: I pounce from above and land with you underfoot.

lines.zh: 龙炎弹没打中，土被烧成了玻璃。
lines.en: The fireball missed and turned soil to glass.

lines.zh: 我的爪子比你的剑长三倍。
lines.en: My claws are three times your sword's length.

lines.zh: 你退回巢口，那是我最熟的地方。
lines.en: You retreat to the nest mouth, where I know every stone.

lines.zh: 这一下留了力，下一口不会。
lines.en: That strike held back. The next bite will not.

lines.zh: 龙鳞破土，我先闻到你才看见你。
lines.en: Scales break the soil; I smell you before I see you.

lines.zh: 这片坡够暖，适合一条龙醒来。
lines.en: This slope is warm enough to wake a dragon.

lines.zh: 我从露天龙巢里抬头，天很小。
lines.en: I raise my head from the open nest; the sky looks small.

lines.zh: 深洞里的龙骨响了一声，我睁眼。
lines.en: A bone shifts in the deep cave, and I open my eyes.

lines.zh: 幼龙只有十点生命，也敢吼。
lines.en: A hatchling has ten points of life and still roars.

lines.zh: 我踩碎巢边的旧蛋壳。
lines.en: I crush an old eggshell by the nest.

lines.zh: 温度低于零下五度的地方，我不去。
lines.en: I do not settle where the temperature drops below five.

lines.zh: 恶地太干，丛林太挤，我另找坡。
lines.en: Badlands too dry, jungle too tight; I find my own slope.

lines.zh: 我出生时就能烧穿一层树皮。
lines.en: At birth I could burn through a layer of bark.

lines.zh: 龙的巢穴空了很久，该有主人了。
lines.en: The dragon roost has stood empty. Time it had a master.

lines.zh: 我抖落身上的土，整片林子听见了。
lines.en: I shake off the dirt and the whole forest hears.

lines.zh: 第一声龙吼，总是先给天空听。
lines.en: A dragon's first roar is always for the sky.

lines.zh: 这地方有肉味，也有铁味。
lines.en: This place smells of meat and of iron.

lines.zh: 我从蛋里出来时，巢已经属于我。
lines.en: The nest was mine the moment I left the egg.

lines.zh: 我从岩缝里爬出，龙鳞还湿。
lines.en: I crawl from the rock cleft, my scales still wet.

lines.zh: 这片坡的暖意把我孵了出来。
lines.en: The warmth of this slope hatched me.

lines.zh: 同族的龙息都烧不动我，你这点火？
lines.en: Even kin's breath cannot scorch me. That little flame?

lines.zh: 从这么高摔下来，我的翅膀丢了面子。
lines.en: Falling from this height shames my wings.

lines.zh: 水灌进鼻子，我讨厌这种凉。
lines.en: Water up my snout. I hate this cold.

lines.zh: 震得我耳朵里全是回音。
lines.en: The blast leaves echoes ringing in my ears.

lines.zh: 又一支箭，卡在鳞缝里。
lines.en: Another arrow, wedged between my scales.

lines.zh: 这咒语在我鳞下爬，很烦。
lines.en: This spell crawls beneath my scales. Irritating.

lines.zh: 巢里很久没有肉味了。
lines.en: It has been long since meat smelled in this nest.

lines.zh: 天雷打在我背上，像被同族拍了一下。
lines.en: Lightning struck my back like a kin's slap.

lines.zh: 掉出世界时，连龙鳞都在飘。
lines.en: Falling out of the world, even my scales drift.
